abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Alvenor lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Alvenor lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Harbor Street Patients.
